citation: Wu et al. Cells 2020;9:1027
what_it_actually_is: Matriptase cleaves TROP2 and EpCAM in keratinocytes. Associated claudins fall. Chloroquine rescues claudin-1 and claudin-7 and accumulates cleaved TROP2/EpCAM.
why_not_a_hit: Lysosomal claudin loss after TROP2 destabilization, but the claudins are 1 and 7, not 4, and the trigger is protease cleavage, not an ADC.

citation: Wu et al. J Clin Invest 2017;127:623-34
what_it_actually_is: Matriptase cleavage of EpCAM destabilizes intestinal claudins (mainly claudin-7) and dysregulates IEC homeostasis.
why_not_a_hit: EpCAM not TROP2-ADC; CLDN7 not CLDN4; no ADC.

citation: Zhao/Wu et al. J Immunother Cancer 2026;14:e012265
what_it_actually_is: TROP2 KO and naked hRS7 (SG antibody, not the ADC) lower claudin-7 / occludin by IF/IHC in TNBC; immune infiltration rises.
why_not_a_hit: Wrong claudin (7 not 4); antibody not ADC; no lysosome inhibitor or LAMP1-CLDN assay.

citation: Okajima et al. Mol Cancer Ther 2021;20:2329-40
what_it_actually_is: Dato-DXd binds TROP2, internalizes, and releases DXd after lysosomal protease cleavage.
why_not_a_hit: ADC/TROP2 lysosomal trafficking. CLDN4 is not measured.

citation: Cardillo et al. Clin Cancer Res 2011;17:3157-69
what_it_actually_is: hRS7-SN-38 (SG/IMMU-132) binds Trop-2 and is cytotoxic in Trop-2+ xenografts.
why_not_a_hit: ADC efficacy. No CLDN4 protein-fate or lysosome-CLDN4 data.

citation: Goldenberg et al. Oncotarget 2015;6:22496-512
what_it_actually_is: SG characterization: Trop-2 binding, internalization, SN-38 delivery.
why_not_a_hit: Same: TROP2/ADC, not CLDN4 lysosomal degradation.

citation: Nakatsukasa et al. Am J Pathol 2010;177:1344-55
what_it_actually_is: PLA: TACSTD2 sits next to CLDN4 (and CLDN1/7/TJP1) on cornea. Co-IP of CLDN4 is negative.
why_not_a_hit: Proximity, not ADC, not lysosomal CLDN4 loss.

citation: Van Itallie / Fredriksson et al. PLOS ONE 2015;10:e0117074
what_it_actually_is: CLDN4-BioID in MDCK II lists TROP-2 among Cldn4-neighborhood proteins (Table 2).
why_not_a_hit: Proximity MS, not ADC treatment, not CLDN4 degradation.

citation: Cong et al. J Cell Sci 2015;128:2271-86
what_it_actually_is: mAChR/ERK phosphorylates CLDN4 at S195; β-arrestin2 / clathrin internalize CLDN4; further loss is ubiquitin-dependent.
why_not_a_hit: CLDN4 internalization/degradation exists, but the stimulus is carbachol, not an ADC, and the terminal step is stated as ubiquitylation, not a lysosome-rescue experiment.

citation: Li et al. FASEB J 2021;35:e21356
what_it_actually_is: Nutrient starvation in IPEC-J2: CLDN1/3/4 protein falls in a lysosome-dependent way. CLDN3/4 use dynamin-dependent, clathrin/caveolae-independent endocytosis.
why_not_a_hit: CLDN4 can be lysosomally degraded, but the trigger is starvation, not ADC.

citation: Li et al. Arch Toxicol 2021;95:1753-69
what_it_actually_is: DON accelerates endocytosis and lysosomal degradation of TJ proteins. Dynasore protects CLDN3/4; JNK mediates CLDN4/ZO-1 endocytosis.
why_not_a_hit: Mycotoxin, not ADC.

citation: Ogawa et al. Histochem Cell Biol 2012;138:323-38
what_it_actually_is: EGF downregulates CLDN4 protein in ovarian serous lines via MEK/ERK (post-translational).
why_not_a_hit: Growth-factor degradation of CLDN4, not ADC, and lysosome vs proteasome is not the ADC experiment.

citation: Ikari et al. Sci Rep 2019;9:10254
what_it_actually_is: In MDCK, chloroquine (not lactacystin) raises WT CLDN2 and CLDN4, consistent with constitutive lysosomal turnover.
why_not_a_hit: Constitutive CLDN4 lysosomal turnover. No ADC.

citation: Yuan / Saeki et al. BMC Cancer 2011;11:61
what_it_actually_is: CPE peptide targeting CLDN3/4 delivers rGel into endosome/lysosome; cargo is trapped unless an R9 escape motif is added.
why_not_a_hit: Ligand-driven trafficking of the toxin cargo, not a measurement that CLDN4 itself is degraded in lysosomes after an ADC.

citation: Hashimoto et al. Int J Oncol 2013;42:1911-8
what_it_actually_is: CPE-ETA' immunotoxin binds CLDN4 and is described as following the ETA endosome-to-Golgi/ER route, not ADC lysosomal payload release.
why_not_a_hit: Immunotoxin, not ADC; pathway is ETA translocation, not CLDN4 lysosomal degradation.

citation: Nasako / Ikari et al. Int J Mol Sci 2020;21:5909
what_it_actually_is: CLDN1 peptidomimetic PMTPV increases endocytosis and lysosome-dependent degradation of CLDN1 in lung adenocarcinoma spheroids.
why_not_a_hit: CLDN1, not CLDN4; peptide, not ADC.

citation: ASCO 2026 abstract e13006
what_it_actually_is: Paired pre/post-SG MS (mPROBE) of Trop2, TOPO1, HER2/3, Nectin4, SLFN11.
why_not_a_hit: No TJ/claudin proteins reported.

citation: Patent WO2016175551A2
what_it_actually_is: CLDN4 antibody–dendron–doxorubicin conjugate; payload said to release in acidic lysosome/endosome.
why_not_a_hit: Patent, not a peer-reviewed CLDN4 protein-fate paper.

citation: e.g. McDermott et al. Clin Cancer Res 2023 CLDN6-23-ADC
what_it_actually_is: CLDN6 and CLDN18.2 ADCs internalize and release MMAE from lysosomes.
why_not_a_hit: Wrong claudin. They do not report CLDN4 lysosomal degradation.

citation: Sun et al. npj Precis Oncol 2026
what_it_actually_is: Pan-cancer Trop2 multi-omic integration; ADC implications; RNA co-expression with CLDN4/CLDN7.
why_not_a_hit: Transcriptomic association, not CLDN4 lysosomal fate after ADC.
